result.summary: Analysis reveals minor styling inconsistencies in imagery and UI elements.

issues.description: Restaurant cards use clashing art styles, mixing flat 2D vectors with blurred 3D-shaded graphics.
issues.suggestion: Standardize all merchant imagery to a single cohesive visual language.

issues.description: Top-right profile icon appears as an unstyled placeholder with a generic notification dot.
issues.suggestion: Add a silhouette icon or defined borders to the profile button for better polish.
